title: Trial Lesson Detail - Lesson Calendar Entry - SF Trial Lesson Detail - Eligible Record - Button Displayed
description: AC 01.1 - Component - Lesson Calendar button is visible on Trial Lesson detail for SF user flow.
preconditions:
- Actor is logged in to Salesforce as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-1001 exists with status Open and linked student STU-001.
- User can open Trial Lesson detail page.
steps_actions:
1. Open Trial Lesson TL-1001 detail page in Salesforce.
2. Observe the action/navigation area on the detail page.
3. Hover or focus on Lesson Calendar button.
steps_result:
1. Trial Lesson detail page loads.
2. Lesson Calendar button is visible and enabled.
3. Button remains interactive with no disabled state.
steps_data:
1. trial_lesson = TL-1001
2. expected_button = Lesson Calendar
3. expected_state = enabled
suite: LT-99482 - Lesson Calendar Button on Trial Lesson

title: Trial Lesson Detail - Lesson Calendar Entry - Button Interaction - User Selects Button - Calendar Page Opened
description: AC 01.2 - State Transition - Clicking Lesson Calendar from Trial Lesson detail opens Lesson Calendar destination.
preconditions:
- Actor is logged in to Salesforce as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-1001 detail page is open.
- Lesson Calendar feature is accessible in current org.
steps_actions:
1. Click Lesson Calendar button from Trial Lesson TL-1001 detail page.
2. Wait for destination page load completion.
3. Read page header and route indicator.
steps_result:
1. Navigation is triggered from Trial Lesson detail context.
2. Lesson Calendar page is displayed.
3. Header and route indicate Lesson Calendar, not Trial Lesson detail.
steps_data:
1. source_page = trial_lesson_detail
2. destination_page = lesson_calendar
3. expected_header = Lesson Calendar
suite: LT-99482 - Lesson Calendar Button on Trial Lesson

title: Trial Lesson Detail - Lesson Calendar Entry - Repeated Access - Button Clicked Twice - Navigation Remains Stable
description: AC 01.2 - Regression - Repeated use of Lesson Calendar button does not break navigation behavior.
preconditions:
- Actor is logged in to Salesforce as HQ or CM Staff.
- Trial Lesson TL-1002 exists and detail page is accessible.
steps_actions:
1. Open Trial Lesson TL-1002 detail page and click Lesson Calendar.
2. Navigate back to TL-1002 detail page using browser/app back.
3. Click Lesson Calendar again.
steps_result:
1. Lesson Calendar opens from Trial Lesson context.
2. Trial Lesson detail page is shown again.
3. Lesson Calendar opens again without route error or blank state.
steps_data:
1. trial_lesson = TL-1002
2. navigation = back
3. attempt = second_click
suite: LT-99482 - Lesson Calendar Button on Trial Lesson
